reason: Adds a persistent Chat/Agent control that governs whether the current DeepSeek Harness session may use its existing tools and autonomous execution flow without changing the session's underlying permission policies.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中提供持久的 Chat/Agent 切换控件，以控制当前会话是否使用既有工具和自主执行流程。
summaries.en: Provides a persistent Chat/Agent switch in DeepSeek Harness to control whether the current session uses its existing tools and autonomous execution flow.

capabilities: switches the current session between Chat and Agent modes
removes tool schemas and blocks tool execution in Chat mode
restores the existing agent tool behavior in Agent mode
persists mode changes through the session log and across reloads and forks
